mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_mall_customer_account WHERE login_phone = #{phone} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM xsy_mall_customer_account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.login_phone, a.status, a.first_password_change, a.last_login_at, a.version FROM xsy_mall_customer_account a JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.login_phone, a.status, a.first_password_change, a.last_login_at, a.version FROM xsy_mall_customer_account a JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted = FALSE
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM xsy_mall_customer_account a LEFT JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE a.id IN #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_mall_customer_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, first_password_change = FALSE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = CONCAT('2:', id::text) WHERE id = #{accountId} AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE xsy_mall_customer_account SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_login_ip = #{ip}, login_failed_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = CONCAT('2:', id::text) WHERE id = #{accountId} AND deleted = FALSE
